# Vendored libraries

Bundled so the app works offline. Each keeps its own license.

| Folder | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| pdfjs | Mozilla pdf.js (pdfjs-dist, legacy build) | 6.4.299 | Apache-2.0, see LICENSE |
| pdfjs/cmaps.json | Adobe CMap files from pdfjs-dist, packed into one JSON file | 6.4.299 | see CMAPS-LICENSE |
| web-llm | MLC WebLLM (@mlc-ai/web-llm) | 0.2.85 | Apache-2.0, see LICENSE |
| wllama | wllama (@wllama/wllama) | 3.8.1 | MIT, https://github.com/ngxson/wllama |
